statusDetail: Coverage-complete multi-template public audit. The mandatory age and consent gates were evaluated as part of the journey; direct content, video detail, search/listing and sign-in states were inspected through rendered DOM and targeted interaction.

page.framework: server-rendered MPA with Vue custom elements and legacy jQuery
page.notes: Public German media site with mandatory consent and age gates. Distinct routes frequently redirect to home; one representative video detail rendered directly.

paths.description: Homepage, mandatory cookie consent and adult-age gate, plus the underlying primary content listing. Represents entry, consent and browsing.
Video and category/search listing routes. Represents discovery templates; several routes redirected to the homepage, which is itself recorded as a recovery issue.
Representative video detail with player, metadata and recommendations.
User-triggered sign-in dialog and account capability inspection.
Fabricated missing route to inspect HTTP/navigation failure recovery.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not explicitly supported
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast probe matched the emulated preference but found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules. Custom cookie toggles visually replace native checkboxes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast styles, preserve native control affordances, and expose system colors.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no view-transition usage, while the site exposes multiple document routes and modal state changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document transitions for modal and listing state changes and cross-document transitions for compatible navigations, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Long listings provide no scroll-state-aware navigation aid
findings.evidence: The home document is over 6,500 CSS pixels tall, but the DOM probe found no scroll-state/container-query implementation or progress cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight scroll-state-aware header treatment or a progress/back-to-top affordance without scroll event handlers.

findings.summary: Consent and age gates are custom fixed div overlays
findings.evidence: Body inspection identified #cookieBanner, #ageDisclaimerMainBG and #modalWrapMTubes as fixed custom div overlays rather than dialog or popover primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Model modal flows with dialog and transient disclosures with popover/details, preserving focus trapping, Escape and light dismiss semantics where appropriate.

findings.summary: Advertising and repeated upsell controls crowd the content listing
findings.evidence: The rendered DOM repeatedly inserts Anzeigen entfernen controls among nearly every content card, and 62 ad-origin requests transferred about 1.75 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve clear, labelled ad slots, reduce repeated upsell chrome, and defer ads below the first content viewport.

findings.summary: The mandatory age gate is clipped at a 360 px viewport
findings.evidence: The 360x800 screenshot visibly cuts off the logo, heading, paragraphs and the second age-choice button at the right edge. The page locks overflow, so the clipped content is not recoverable by horizontal scrolling.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed/minimum modal widths, use max-inline-size:100%, logical padding and wrapping button layouts, then verify the entire gate at 320 to 400 px.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport styling rather than container responsiveness
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no @container usage despite cards and consent components appearing in multiple widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare containment on reusable card and overlay regions and use size container queries for local adaptations.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and many targets are very small
findings.evidence: The focus probe reported outline-style none and no box shadow on a focused content link; 83 of 159 visible controls measured below 24 px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible indicator and enlarge interactive hit areas to at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, preferably 44 by 44 for primary touch actions.

findings.summary: Invalid routes silently redirect to the homepage
findings.evidence: A request to /does-not-exist-web-uplift-404 ended at the homepage with no not-found message or recovery context. /login likewise redirected before opening the in-page sign-in flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 status and a clear not-found page with search, home and back actions; preserve intent when sign-in routes redirect.

findings.summary: Load performance and visual stability miss the Core Web Vitals bar
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.6 s and CLS 0.698; the CDP trace independently measured LCP 5.13 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset, reserve all late content space and remove expensive early network work.

findings.summary: Late content causes severe layout shift
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.698 and the mobile layout observer recorded CLS 0.102, including a 0.102 shift at about 4.0 seconds.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for banners, media and injected modules and stabilize fonts and consent layout before paint.

findings.summary: The initial page creates a large, blocking request graph
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 341 requests and 8.04 MB transferred, including 22 stylesheets and multiple parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority styles. DOM inspection confirmed many synchronous scripts in head.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, consolidate styles, defer non-critical scripts, reduce redirects and set useful cache headers.

findings.summary: The page ships a broad script bundle before the user passes the gate
findings.evidence: The HAR loaded 78 scripts; DOM inspection found duplicate ph-functions versions, multiple modal utilities, Vue, jQuery and account/payment modules on the gated landing state.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split post-gate and account-only features, deduplicate libraries and load advertising modules only after consent and need.

findings.summary: Some embedded and labelled controls lack correct accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed frame-title and label-content-name-mismatch audits despite an overall accessibility score of 0.92.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every iframe a descriptive title and ensure accessible names contain the visible control label.

findings.summary: The page lacks landmarks, a primary heading and visible focus
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found zero main/navigation landmarks, zero h1 elements on the homepage and a focused link with outline none and no box shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add semantic header/nav/main landmarks, a logical heading hierarchy and persistent :focus-visible styling; manage focus when gates open and close.

findings.summary: Zoom is restricted and the video exposes no caption track
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport because user scaling is restricted; the detail probe found no track elements on the representative video, and the 360 px gate is clipped.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow pinch zoom, repair narrow reflow and provide caption tracks or an equivalent transcript for video content.

findings.summary: The page logs browser errors during load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the errors-in-console audit on the entry page.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve uncaught/network console errors and add production monitoring that groups and fixes recurring client errors.

findings.summary: Image delivery and sizing are inconsistent
findings.evidence: The image audit found 3 images without dimensions, 33 without srcset and 21 in legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width and height, supply responsive srcset/sizes and prefer AVIF/WebP where supported.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two deprecated API warnings, four BFCache failure reasons and DevTools inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated APIs, remove unload/BFCache blockers and clear Chrome Issues panel findings.

findings.summary: Public pages use a generic title and omit meta descriptions
findings.evidence: The homepage title is only Pornhub and has no meta description; the representative detail page also returned title Pornhub with no description.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate unique descriptive titles and concise descriptions for each listing and detail page.

findings.summary: Links and robots signals prevent crawling
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found 18 javascript:void(0) links; Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors and reported 4,068 robots.txt errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for content cards and serve a valid text/plain robots.txt aligned with intended crawl policy.

findings.summary: The localized public site explicitly blocks indexing and lacks a sitemap
findings.evidence: The homepage emits noindex,nofollow, /sitemap.xml returns 404, hreflang is absent and direct utility paths redirect to home.
findings.suggestedFix: If public discovery is intended, remove blanket noindex/nofollow, publish a valid sitemap, expose hreflang alternates and return correct route status codes.

findings.summary: Video detail pages lack structured and social metadata
findings.evidence: The representative video detail probe found no JSON-LD and no Open Graph metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD plus Open Graph and social preview tags matching visible title, thumbnail and duration.

findings.summary: Core security headers and cookie protections are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no CSP or X-Content-Type-Options. Cookie inspection found an rp cookie without Secure and all seven cookies using SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, nosniff and least-privilege SameSite cookie settings; mark every HTTPS cookie Secure.

findings.summary: The gated page starts a large advertising and analytics footprint
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 201 third-party requests and 2.96 MB third-party transfer; trackers included Google Tag Manager and DoubleClick plus TrafficJunky origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Load only essential resources before consent, remove unnecessary trackers, batch analytics and gate advertising behind explicit consent.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defenses are missing
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no CSP, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy, although HSTS and X-Frame-Options are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrictive Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, prefer CSP frame-ancestors and evaluate Trusted Types for the script-heavy application.

findings.summary: Most rendered content is unavailable to a no-JavaScript client
findings.evidence: Discoverability evidence measured only 32% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML. The no-JS crawler view and browser view differ substantially.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render primary listing and detail content and keep navigation/forms functional before JavaScript enhancement.

findings.summary: HTTP failures are converted into misleading success content
findings.evidence: The fabricated 404 path redirected to a normal 200-style homepage with no error explanation or retry/recovery state.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve 404/5xx status semantics and render actionable error states with retry, search and back navigation.

findings.summary: Localized markup still relies heavily on physical CSS directions
findings.evidence: The page correctly sets lang=de, but captured authored CSS repeatedly uses left/right positioning and margins rather than inline/block logical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain correct language metadata and migrate reusable layout rules to logical properties so RTL locales can reuse the same components.

findings.summary: Advertising destinations are presented as primary navigation
findings.evidence: LIVE CAMS and DATING 18+ appear in the main navigation but link directly to ads.trafficjunky.net, without an advertising label.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label sponsored destinations, visually separate them from site navigation and disclose external advertising before navigation.

findings.summary: Responsive and modern image delivery is largely absent
findings.evidence: The image audit found 33 of 37 images without srcset and 21 legacy-format assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive AVIF/WebP variants and send only the resolution needed by each card.

findings.summary: Substantial work runs before the user clears mandatory gates
findings.evidence: The gated load issued 341 requests, including 78 scripts and 74 fetch/XHR requests, before the user could access content.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay ads, recommendations, account modules and non-essential analytics until consent and user intent; prioritize only gate-critical resources.

findings.summary: Third-party advertising dominates a heavy initial transfer
findings.evidence: The page transferred 8.04 MB, with 2.96 MB across 201 third-party requests; TrafficJunky alone transferred about 1.75 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a pre-consent third-party budget, remove low-value vendors and defer/collapse below-fold ad media.
